acceptance: Board choices include concise parent context when names collide or refer to subboards, preserving current permission filtering, archive exclusions and direct compose links.

title: Confirm and centralize the forum's public social account links
acceptance: Owner confirms the canonical forum versus personal account destinations; render them from shared configuration and verify safe external-link behavior without publishing or changing any account.
authorization: Confirm whether the forum footer should link @symforum or the existing personal Twitter/LinkedIn destinations before changing public branding.

title: Let work-in-progress onboarding choose its actual pillar
acceptance: The Share a work in progress action offers the active AI/Gaming/Web3/Hacking/Music destinations described in its copy instead of always routing to AI; preserve host-aware links and archive restrictions.

title: Distinguish loading versus empty interest collections
acceptance: Interest fieldsets show loading status while board options are unresolved and an honest empty state if a configured collection has no available boards; do not display an unexplained blank fieldset or auto-follow anything.

title: Validate mute phrase count and length inline
acceptance: Show per-field guidance/count for the existing 20-phrase/80-character contract before saving, associate errors with the textarea and preserve input after failure; do not alter mute scope, duration semantics or backend limits.

title: Enhancement: expose a safe x402 readiness reason contract
acceptance: Return closed public reasons distinguishing setup, stale verification and exhausted existing credits; disclose no credentials, account balances or private intents. Preserve admission decisions and credit limits.

title: Enhancement: document facilitator readiness refresh ownership
acceptance: Document the existing 60-second readiness lease, authenticated wallet requirement and one-hour verification policy, including which failures must remain fail-closed. Documentation must not trigger a refresh or change configuration.

title: Coverage enhancement: race readiness refresh against exhausted credits
acceptance: Using isolated mocked state, race an outstanding quote with another intent's settlement reservation and prove the existing credit cap is not exceeded. Extend rather than duplicate current exhaustion tests; make no facilitator call.

title: Enhancement: publish a machine-readable x402 error taxonomy
acceptance: Define versioned closed error/status codes for expired, held, unauthenticated and setup-disabled resources, while retaining private no-store headers and never exposing provider bodies or raw errors.

title: Coverage enhancement: verify proxy header privacy across every research response
acceptance: Table-test success, challenge, rejection and unknown-state responses for private/no-store, nosniff and appropriate Vary headers; ensure neither a CDN nor a different authenticated owner can receive another owner's response.

title: Coverage enhancement: verify bearer and cookie authority cannot be mixed
acceptance: In isolated HTTP tests, supply conflicting cookie and bearer identities and prove one documented authentication precedence applies consistently to quote, prepare, resource and RPC paths. No identity union or cross-owner report access is permitted.

title: Coverage enhancement: malformed payment header boundary matrix
acceptance: Add boundary cases for duplicate fields, non-object JSON, invalid base64, excessive nesting and exact size limits around the existing payment payload parser. Preserve the strict asset, destination, resource, memo and v0 requirements.

title: Enhancement: add a no-payment x402 client integration example
acceptance: Provide an offline fixture-based client example showing catalog discovery, challenge inspection and owner-authenticated receipt checks. Clearly separate manual approval from resource discovery; never auto-pay or include secrets.

title: Source-unverified deployment check: confirm x402 receiving readiness
acceptance: An authorized operator verifies facilitator free-credit evidence, recipient ATA and configured public identity before considering activation. Source inspection alone must not be reported as a live paid flow verification.
authorization: Requires authorized provider-dashboard access and receiving-account verification. No activation, spending, top-up or live payment is authorized by this audit.

title: Enhancement proposal: additional x402 payment assets
acceptance: Prepare a threat model and compatibility proposal for any asset beyond the fixed USDC product. Do not change the current mint, price, facilitator requirements or settlement gates until separately approved and verified.
authorization: Additional assets, SYMF charging, product pricing or fee changes require explicit owner approval and facilitator support evidence.

title: Enhancement: owner-only paginated research receipt history
acceptance: Add a bounded indexed cursor history without increasing per-page limits; retain protected-state visibility separately and enforce owner authorization on every page. Existing recent-history behavior remains compatible.

title: Enhancement: downloadable fulfilled research JSON
acceptance: Offer an authenticated attachment response for an already fulfilled frozen report, with a safe deterministic filename, private/no-store headers and no additional model, provider, settlement or credit reservation work.

title: Enhancement: version the research export envelope
acceptance: Wrap exported frozen reports in an explicit schema-version envelope while preserving the existing product identifier, exact mint, original generatedAt/metricsAsOf and report hash. Existing stored report hashes must not be rewritten.

title: Enhancement: bounded CSV export of existing research facts
acceptance: Derive a CSV from an already authorized fulfilled report only; protect spreadsheet formula cells, quote newlines correctly, preserve unavailable values and original timestamps, and perform no fresh data or model calls.

title: Enhancement: show the frozen research content fingerprint
acceptance: Expose the existing deterministic report fingerprint to the authorized receipt view and export envelope, explaining that it identifies frozen content rather than guaranteeing trading outcomes or current prices. No private payload hash is publicized.

title: Coverage enhancement: report calculation edge cases
acceptance: Extend report tests with zero liquidity, absent market cap but present FDV, extreme finite values and missing holder counts; reports must not invent valuations, divide by zero or silently substitute FDV for market cap.

title: Enhancement: distinguish report age from payment finality
acceptance: Provide owner-facing receipt fields that separately identify metricsAsOf, generatedAt, settlement signature and finalizedAt. Never label old frozen research as newly updated merely because a payment was finalized later.

title: Coverage enhancement: exported source URL safety
acceptance: Test HTTPS source validation against credentials, ports, encoded delimiters and unsupported schemes. Export rendering must escape source labels and preserve exact report provenance without fetching source URLs server-side.

title: Enhancement: read-only research availability metadata
acceptance: Add public non-personal metadata describing the fixed product, frozen-report freshness rule and manual payment lifecycle. Keep report existence, wallet identity, owner history and individual settlement states private.

title: Enhancement proposal: asynchronous bulk research exports
acceptance: Produce a bounded design with explicit owner scope, cancellation, retention and quota accounting before adding batch generation. Do not assume the single-intent price or existing free credits authorize bulk model/data work.
authorization: New bulk products, pricing, generation cadence or resource allocation require explicit approval; existing paid research behavior remains unchanged.

title: Enhancement: cursor pagination for exact-mint project directory
acceptance: Add indexed cursor pagination for the directory currently bounded to 24 projects, preserving exact-mint lookup and public-safe fields. Each request remains bounded; no user-controlled unbounded scan is introduced.

title: Enhancement: disclose bounded affiliation list coverage
acceptance: Return a hasMore indicator or bounded pagination for project claims currently limited to 12, so clients cannot imply the returned subset is the entire team. Preserve public self-declared claim semantics.

title: Enhancement: owner-controlled affiliation retraction
acceptance: Add an authenticated, rate-limited operation to retract only the caller's own affiliation claim, preserving other claims and project identity. Define whether retraction is soft-deleted and ensure public lists exclude retracted claims without deleting financial records.

title: Enhancement: machine-readable self-declared affiliation label
acceptance: Return an explicit self-declared provenance value for project affiliations and document that wallet linking proves account control, not team membership. Never imply a verified owner badge from an unverified claim.

title: Coverage enhancement: exact-mint project substitution matrix
acceptance: Extend isolated tests for same-symbol/different-mint, expired verified-mint metadata and concurrent create/update cases. A hub must remain bound to one exact verified mint without accepting ticker-only identity or duplicating the hub.

title: Enhancement: bounded project community summary
acceptance: Add a read-only project summary from existing local records, identifying counts as bounded samples where complete aggregates do not exist. Do not fetch external market data or expose private submissions, payments or watchlists.

title: Coverage enhancement: hostile affiliation description and website rendering
acceptance: Test backend length/HTTPS constraints and consuming renderers with HTML-like text, bidirectional controls and malicious link labels. Claims remain plain content; server processing must not fetch arbitrary claim URLs.

title: Enhancement: owner-readable project claim status
acceptance: Return the caller's current project claim state and its own timestamps using bounded indexed reads, distinguishing saved self-declarations from any future review state. Do not expose another user's private settings.

title: Enhancement proposal: cryptographically verified project ownership
acceptance: Specify a proof and revocation model distinguishing website control, mint authority and self-declared affiliation before introducing verified ownership. No existing self-declared claim is silently promoted to verified.
authorization: Owner verification policy, proof authority and moderation/revocation permissions require an explicit product/security decision.

title: Enhancement proposal: project claim moderation workflow
acceptance: Define a least-privilege moderation design with reason codes, audit records and owner notification before implementing hide/review authority. Preserve readable historical financial receipts and do not grant agents new moderation permissions automatically.
authorization: New moderation authority, retention policy and who may hide an affiliation require owner confirmation.

title: Enhancement: watchlist coverage and freshness metadata
acceptance: Return the age and availability of the existing local market sample for each watched mint, distinguishing unobserved, stale and fresh states. Do not create provider calls, promise continuous monitoring or change alert schedules.

title: Enhancement: owner-only cursor alert history
acceptance: Add an indexed paginated alert-history API with the existing 50-item maximum page size and exact owner filtering. Preserve current recent-alert compatibility and never return another account's thresholds or watchlist.

title: Enhancement: bounded unread alert query
acceptance: Provide unread filtering using an appropriate owner-scoped index rather than filtering only a recent fixed window. Return bounded pagination/coverage metadata instead of claiming a complete unread count from a truncated sample.

title: Enhancement: bounded multi-alert acknowledgement
acceptance: Allow a small validated list of alert IDs to be acknowledged atomically after checking every row's owner. Reject oversized or foreign-ID batches without exposing their existence; retain single-alert behavior.

title: Coverage enhancement: alert continuation under concurrent watch edits
acceptance: Use mocked pagination beyond one 100-row page while watches are edited or removed. Verify no cross-owner leakage, duplicate threshold crossing or stale sample overwrite, and preserve the existing source/version freshness fence.

title: Enhancement: explain sample-driven alert semantics in API metadata
acceptance: Document and return safe capability metadata explaining that crossings are evaluated on accepted samples rather than every trade. Clarify stale/no-sample behavior without changing budgets, polling cadence or delivery guarantees.

title: Coverage enhancement: edited thresholds against existing baseline
acceptance: Document and test whether a threshold edit applies to the next accepted sample while retaining the existing baseline. Cover exact equality, explicit null clearing and omitted-field preservation; do not silently change crossing semantics.

title: Enhancement: private watchlist export
acceptance: Provide a bounded owner-authenticated export of existing watched exact mints and thresholds with private/no-store headers. Do not fetch live prices or include wallet balances, other users or inferred trading activity.

title: Source-unverified investigation: alert retention during ingestion outages
acceptance: Confirm whether retention cleanup depends solely on accepted snapshot ingestion and quantify any bounded backlog risk using isolated fixtures. Recommend a minimal bounded remedy only if needed; do not add or alter production schedules in this task.

title: Enhancement proposal: opt-in external alert delivery
acceptance: Design explicit opt-in Telegram/email delivery with deduplication, uncertain-send holds, consent revocation and delivery caps. Existing in-app alerts remain free and unchanged; no provider is connected or message sent by the design task.
authorization: External recipients, delivery permissions, provider usage and any new schedule/cap allocation require owner approval.

title: Fix mint-and-status bounty queries filtering after the 32-row limit
acceptance: Add a matching mint/status/updatedAt index and apply both filters before the existing bounded take. A fixture with 32 newer nonmatching statuses must still return an older matching bounty; preserve no-mint and omitted-status behavior.
receipt: PR #256 / 9f807188: approved production index deployment and bounded read-only index/public-query verification passed; website release verified. No production records created.

title: Enhancement: owner payment receipt cursor history
acceptance: Add bounded indexed pagination beyond the current latest 30 private receipts, preserving owner authorization and uncertain-state visibility. Do not clear, expire or retry payments while browsing history.

title: Enhancement: sponsor submission pagination
acceptance: Provide a bounded cursor for sponsors beyond the latest 50 submissions while other contributors retain access only to their own submission. Reject forged work/submission ownership and do not broaden public visibility.

title: Enhancement: bounded pagination for opted-in tip recipients
acceptance: Add an indexed cursor for the public opt-in recipient directory currently limited to 24. Immediately honor acceptance opt-out and account bans/disablement without exposing private contact details or nonconsenting wallets.

title: Coverage enhancement: recipient revocation across payment preparation
acceptance: Test opting out, unlinking a wallet or disabling an account between recipient discovery and preparing/opening a tip. Confirm the intended existing authority checks and that already uncertain/verified receipts are never deleted or replayed.

title: Enhancement: explicit bounty funding capability metadata
acceptance: Expose/document that creating a bounty is an unfunded pledge and selection does not escrow funds or guarantee payout. Derive status from existing records only, distinguishing selected, payment opened, held and verified.

title: Enhancement: read-only private payment verification explanation
acceptance: Expose a closed owner-only explanation of ready/opened/checking/held/verified states and the last safe check timestamp. Never expose RPC credentials/raw errors, infer absence from timeout or offer replay of an uncertain payment.

title: Coverage enhancement: cancelled bounty race with reward verification
acceptance: Race isolated cancellation, reward opening and receipt verification transitions. Cancellation must not override an opened/held/checking/verified payment, while a never-opened expired preparation may follow existing cancellation rules.

title: Enhancement: supporter proof provenance without exposing balances
acceptance: Expose only consented supporter eligibility and proof checked/expiry times; explain that the badge is not a swap fee discount. Keep raw token balances, wallet holdings and nonconsenting supporter state private.

title: Enhancement proposal: escrow or automated bounty payout
acceptance: Produce a separate threat model for escrow custody, cancellation disputes and payout authority. Do not alter the existing sponsor-approved transfer flow or automatically sign, broadcast or retry a reward.
authorization: Escrow deployment, custody assumptions, financial authority and real transactions need explicit owner authorization and separate security review.

title: Enhancement: paginated verified promotion transparency receipts
acceptance: Provide bounded indexed cursors beyond the current latest 20 public verified promotion receipts. Expose only existing public signature, exact mint, split amounts and completion time; never include payer identities, unknown preparations or private content.

title: Enhancement: explicitly label treasury report coverage
acceptance: Make API/UI wording explicitly identify verified promotion receipts, not total treasury balance or all swap-fee revenue. Preserve historyComplete semantics so an incomplete projection cannot be represented as all-time complete revenue.

title: Enhancement: export verified promotion receipts safely
acceptance: Add a bounded paginated JSON/CSV export derived from public verified receipt projections only, with exact integer raw amounts, decimals, signatures and split conservation. No RPC or re-verification is performed during export.

title: Coverage enhancement: transparency backfill interleaved with new receipts
acceptance: Interleave multiple bounded backfill pages with a newly verified receipt and repeated cursor submission. Materialized totals and receipt count must remain exact once, with no payment state mutation or hidden hold release.

title: Enhancement: private paginated promotion purchase history
acceptance: Add owner-indexed cursor history without reducing protected-state visibility or increasing page caps. History views must not expire, prepare, submit or replay financial operations as a side effect.

title: Enhancement: public promotion inventory availability summary
acceptance: Expose a read-only bounded availability summary derived from the same existing inventory rules, distinguishing current slots and queue capacity without promising reservation. Keep five active slots, price, 24-hour duration and 50% burn unchanged.

title: Coverage enhancement: treasury or mint configuration change preserves old receipts
acceptance: With isolated configuration fixtures, prove current-mint/treasury summaries cannot mix historical identities or relabel their verified amounts. Historical receipt records remain immutable and no real configuration changes are made.

title: Enhancement: promotion split integrity diagnostics
acceptance: Add an internal read-only bounded integrity report checking stored promotion amount equals treasury plus burn and that projection decimals match. Report closed aggregate inconsistency counts; never repair, refund or activate a payment automatically.

title: Source-unverified investigation: full treasury and swap-fee accounting coverage
acceptance: Map which existing verified swap fee and treasury records could support truthful additional accounting without new RPC calls. Produce a design separating promotion receipts, referral fees, actual token balances and unrealized valuations; do not claim current full treasury reconciliation.

title: Enhancement proposal: on-chain treasury balance reconciliation
acceptance: Design an explicit bounded independent on-chain reconciliation using exact treasury/mint identities and dated finalized evidence. Distinguish incoming fees, burns, outgoing transfers and current balances; never infer realized revenue from token price or change payment holds.
authorization: New production RPC/indexing work requires quota allocation and explicit operator approval; transactions, treasury transfers, new spend and schedule changes are not authorized by this audit.
